description: Lists the people and bots in the Notion workspace, or reads one of them. Each user is reduced to id, type (person or bot), name, and email for a person when Notion includes it; a bot also carries workspace_name. With user_id set to "me", returns the DataToRAG connection's own bot user, whose workspace_name names the workspace this connection is in. The result is {results, has_more, next_cursor}, with the same shape when there are no results. has_more true means more results exist than this page holds, and next_cursor is the cursor argument that returns them. A single user comes back in the same shape, as a one-item results list.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

cursor.description: The next_cursor value from an earlier call with the same arguments. Returns the page of results after that one. Absent for the start of the list.

page_size.description: How many results one call returns, from 1 to 100. Default 50. A full page comes back with has_more true and a next_cursor for the rest.

user_id.description: A Notion user id, with or without dashes, or "me" for the connection's own bot user. Absent lists the workspace.

name: notion-mcp__notion_list_users
